Definition: from G2453; to become a Judæan, i.e. "Judaize":--live as the Jews.
BiblicalUsage: To live as the Jews is the charge Paul lays on Peter at Antioch. In Galatians 2:14 he asks Peter before them all, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews, when thou thyself livest after the manner of Gentiles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the question cuts to the heart of the gospel: if Peter lived free of the law, he had no right to lay it on the Gentiles.
